sqlMap.select: SELECT DUTY, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(DUTY,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#) DUTY_NAME, A.CPNY_ID, AFFIRM_LEVEL, TO_CHAR(A.UPDATE_DATE,'yyyy-mm-dd') OP_DATE, B.LOCAL_NAME FROM SY_AFFIRM_LEVEL_SETUP A, HR_EMPLOYEE B WHERE A.UPDATED_BY = B.PERSON_ID(+) AND A.CPNY_ID = #interCpnyID# ORDER BY AFFIRM_LEVEL
SELECT S.CODE_NO, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(S.CODE_NO, #interLanguage#) CODE_NAME FROM SY_CODE S, SY_CODE_PARAM P WHERE S.CODE_NO = P.CODE_NO AND S.PARENT_CODE_NO = '14014036' AND P.CPNY_ID = #interCpnyID#
sqlMap.insert: insert into SY_AFFIRM_LEVEL_SETUP( CPNY_ID, DUTY, AFFIRM_LEVEL, CREATE_DATE, CREATED_BY, UPDATE_DATE, UPDATED_BY, ACTIVITY ) VALUES( #interCpnyID#, #DUTY#, #AFFIRM_LEVEL#, sysdate, #supervisorPersonId#, sysdate, #supervisorPersonId#, 1 )
sqlMap.update: UPDATE SY_AFFIRM_LEVEL_SETUP T SET AFFIRM_LEVEL = #AFFIRM_LEVEL#, UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE, UPDATED_BY = #supervisorPersonId:VARCHAR# WHERE CPNY_ID = #interCpnyID# AND DUTY = #DUTY#
sqlMap.delete: DELETE FROM SY_AFFIRM_LEVEL_SETUP T WHERE CPNY_ID = #interCpnyID# AND DUTY = #DUTY#
sqlMap.select: SELECT S.CODE_NO,S.PARENT_CODE_NO,S.OPERATION_ID,P.CPNY_ID,SG.CONTENT AS CODENAME FROM SY_CODE S, SY_CODE_PARAM P, SY_GLOBAL_NAME SG WHERE S.CODE_NO = P.CODE_NO AND S.CODE_NO = SG.NO(+) AND SG.LANGUAGE(+) = #interLanguage:VARCHAR# AND P.CPNY_ID = #interCpnyID:VARCHAR# AND S.PARENT_CODE_NO = 3588 AND S.ACTIVITY = 1 AND P.ACTIVITY = 1
SELECT DUTY, A.CPNY_ID, AFFIRM_LEVEL FROM SY_AFFIRM_LEVEL_SETUP A WHERE CPNY_ID = #interCpnyID# AND DUTY = #DUTY#
select count(*) from sy_affirmor_list where DUTY_NO =#DUTY_NO:VARCHAR# AND cpny_id=#interCpnyID:VARCHAR# AND PERSON_ID IS NULL
